Download

Saves a separate page with this exact design locked. Players can only type their name and number, then download their prints.

The PNGs are 300 dpi with a transparent background, ready for a printer: front 11 × 11 in, back 12 × 14 in. The SVGs stay editable in Illustrator, Inkscape or Figma.

Gradients need DTF or sublimation printing. For screen printing, choose One colour under Print colours.
